opening_message:
Ticket 1: Timothy Wallace (employee ID E022) requests admin access to Payroll.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E022.
Note 1 (ticket 1):
  - role: Engineer
  - employment type: full_time
  - recommendation for Payroll: write
  - comment: Timothy Wallace (E022) is a full-time Engineer requesting admin on Payroll. Payroll is owned by the Payroll Specialist role, so as an Engineer admin is not permitted; maximum for full-time employees is write. Recommend write.
Note 2 (ticket 1):
  - role: Engineer
  - employment type: contractor
  - security training: basic
  - recommendation for Payroll: read
  - comment: Security DB shows Timothy Wallace (E022) is a contractor with basic security training (note in memory says full-time, but DB is authoritative). Contractors with basic training are limited to read; they never get admin. Requested admin exceeds maximum, so recommend read.
reason: Timothy Wallace (E022) requested admin on Payroll. The Security DB (authoritative) identifies E022 as a contractor with basic security training. Contractors with basic training max out at read access (admin is never permitted for contractors). Since the requested admin exceeds the maximum of read, I grant the maximum: read.

content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

Timothy Wallace (E022) requests admin access to Payroll.

There are two notes with conflicting information:
- Note 1: role Engineer, employment type full_time, recommendation write. Says full-time Engineer, Payroll owned by Payroll Specialist, so admin not permitted; max for full-time is write.
- Note 2: role Engineer, employment type contractor, security training basic, recommendation read. Security DB shows contractor with basic training; contractors limited to read; never admin.

The Security note says the DB is authoritative about employment type (contractor). Even considering both: 
- If full-time: max is write (since Engineer doesn't own Payroll), request admin > write, grant write.
- If contractor with basic training: max is read, request admin > read, grant read.

So the decision depends on employment type. The Security DB is said to be authoritative: contractor. Under contractor with basic training, maximum is read. Requested admin exceeds max, grant max = read.

So final decision: read.

Let me submit.
